title: Munder Difflin: Run an Office of AI Clones on Your Machine
description:
Munder Difflin is a free desktop app that turns your AI coding tools into a team of coordinated agents. Each agent gets memory, a mailbox, and a desk on a virtual office floor — and a boss agent called Michael routes tasks between them. Install with one command and let your clones work while you sleep.
